# Support — YT6 Clarity Benchmark

YT6 provides support for:
- benchmark reproduction
- clarity testing
- drift detection
- stability evaluation
- reproducibility confirmation

## How to Get Support
Support is available through:
- GitHub Issues
- Email (listed in README)
- Benchmark submission form (coming soon)

## What We Support
- reproduction errors
- dataset questions
- scoring clarification
- benchmark interpretation
- licensing inquiries

## What We Do Not Support
- modifying YT6 scoring rules
- altering datasets
- bypassing reproducibility checks
- non-clarity-related AI issues
